verses.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
verses.pt: Depois disto fez-me sair para fora, ao átrio exterior, que dá para o norte; e me levou às câmaras que estavam defronte do largo vazio, e que estavam defronte do edifício, do lado do norte.
verses.en_web: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
verses.en_bbe: And he took me out into the inner square in the direction of the north: and he took me into the rooms which were opposite the separate place and opposite the building to the north.

verses.en: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
verses.pt: Do comprimento de cem côvados era esse edifício, e da largura de cinqüenta côvados.
verses.en_web: Before the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.
verses.en_bbe: On the north side it was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide,

verses.en: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.pt: Em frente dos vinte côvados, que tinha o átrio interior, e em frente do pavimento que tinha o átrio exterior, havia galeria contra galeria em três andares.
verses.en_web: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the third floor.
verses.en_bbe: Opposite the space of twenty cubits which was part of the inner square, and opposite the stone floor of the outer square. There were covered ways facing one another on the third floor.

verses.en: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
verses.pt: E diante das câmaras havia um passeio que dava para o átrio interior, e que tinha dez côvados de largura e cem côvados de comprimento; e as suas portas davam para o norte.
verses.en_web: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.
verses.en_bbe: And in front of the rooms was a walk, ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long; and their doors were facing north.

verses.en: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
verses.pt: Ora, as câmaras superiores eram mais estreitas; porque as galerias tomavam destas mais espaço do que das de baixo e das do meio do edifício.
verses.en_web: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these, more than from the lower and the middle, in the building.
verses.en_bbe: And the higher rooms were shorter: for the covered ways took up more space from these than from the lower and middle rooms.

verses.en: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
verses.pt: Porque elas eram de três andares e não tinham colunas como as colunas dos átrios; por isso desde o chão se iam estreitando mais do que as de baixo e as do meio.
verses.en_web: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.
verses.en_bbe: For they were on three floors, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the outer square; so the highest was narrower than the lowest and middle floors from the earth level.

verses.en: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
verses.pt: No lado de fora, em paralelo às cãmaras e defronte delas no caminho do áteio exterior, havia um muro que tinha cinqüenta côvados de comprimento.
verses.en_web: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, its length was fifty cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And the wall which went outside by the side of the rooms, in the direction of the outer square in front of the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

verses.en: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
verses.pt: Pois o comprimento da série de câmaras que estavam no átrio exterior era de cinqüenta côvados, enquanto o da série que estava defronte do templo era de cem côvados.
verses.en_web: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, before the temple were one hundred cubits.
verses.en_bbe: For the rooms in the outer square were fifty cubits long: and in front of the Temple was a space of a hundred cubits.

verses.en: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
verses.pt: Por debaixo destas câmaras estava a entrada do lado do oriente, para quem entra nelas do átrio exterior.
verses.en_web: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
verses.en_bbe: And under these rooms was the way in from the east side, as one goes into them from the outer square at the head of the outer wall.

verses.en: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
verses.pt: Na grossura do muro do átrio que dava para o oriente, diante do lugar separado, e diante do edifício, havia também câmaras,
verses.en_web: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.
verses.en_bbe: (And he took me) to the south, and in front of the separate place and in front of the building there were rooms.

verses.en: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
verses.pt: com um caminho diante delas, que eram da mesma feição das câmaras que davam para o norte, sendo do mesmo comprimento, e da mesma largura, com as mesmas saídas, disposições e portas.
verses.en_web: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north; according to their length so was their width: and all their exits were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a walk in front of them like that by the rooms on the north; they were equally long and wide; and the ways out of them were the same in design and had the same sort of doors.

verses.en: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
verses.pt: E conforme eram as portas das câmaras que davam para o sul, era também a porta no topo do caminho, isto é, do caminho bem em frente do muro à direita para quem entra.
verses.en_web: According to the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.
verses.en_bbe: And under the rooms on the south was a door at the head of the outer wall in the direction of the east as one goes in.

verses.en: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
verses.pt: Então me disse: As câmaras do norte, e as câmaras do sul, que estão diante do lugar separado, são câmaras santas, em que os sacerdotes que se chegam ao Senhor comerão as coisas santíssimas. Ali porão as coisas santíssimas, as ofertas de cereais, as ofertas pelo pecado, e as ofertas pela culpa; porque o lugar é santo.
verses.en_web: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are before the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, The north rooms and the south rooms in front of the separate place are the holy rooms, where the priests who come near the Lord take the most holy things for their food: there the most holy things are placed, with the meal offering and the sin-offering and the offering for error; for the place is holy.

verses.en: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
verses.pt: Quando os sacerdotes entrarem, não sairão do santuário para o átrio exterior, mas porão ali as suas vestiduras em que ministram, porque elas são santas; e vestir-se-ão doutras vestiduras, e assim se aproximarão do lugar pertencente ao povo.
verses.en_web: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court, but they shall lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach to that which is for the people.”
verses.en_bbe: When the priests go in, they may not go out of the holy place into the outer square, and there they are to put the robes in which they do the work of the Lord's house, for they are holy: and they have to put on other clothing before they come near that which has to do with the people.

verses.en: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
verses.pt: Tendo ele acabado de medir o templo interior, fez-me sair pelo caminho da porta oriental; e o mediu em redor.
verses.en_web: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had come to the end of measuring the inner house, he took me out to the doorway looking to the east, and took its measure all round.

verses.en: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.pt: Mediu o lado oriental com a cana de medir, quinhentas canas de largura.
verses.en_web: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.
verses.en_bbe: He went round and took the measure of it on the east side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.

verses.en: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.pt: Mediu o lado do norte, quinhentas canas, com a cana de medir.
verses.en_web: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.
verses.en_bbe: And he went round and took the measure of it on the north side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.

verses.en: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
verses.pt: Mediu também o lado do sul, quinhentas canas, com a cana de medir.
verses.en_web: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.en_bbe: And he went round and took the measure of it on the south side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.

verses.en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.pt: Deu uma volta para o lado do ocidente, e mediu quinhentas canas, com a cana de medir.
verses.en_web: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.en_bbe: And he went round and took the measure of it on the west side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.

verses.en: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
verses.pt: Mediu-o pelos quatro lados. Havia um muro em redor, de quinhentas canas de comprimento, e quinhentas de largura, para fazer separação entre o santo e o profano.
verses.en_web: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred, and the width five hundred, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
verses.en_bbe: He took its measure on the four sides: and it had a wall all round, five hundred long and five hundred wide, separating what was holy from what was common.
